Eric Latino is 1 - 5 against Enders.  Eric Enders has never won a race when starting from the #9 spot
(11 - 13 in Rd. 1 when #9)

Enders is 5 - 1 against Latino in prior events. 

Enders with the the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Latino chattered the tires and was loose right at the hit.  He reeled it in, but couldn't chase
Enders down.

Troy Coughlin wins 71% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice.  Aaron Stanfield is 5 - 4 against
Troy in Rd. 1.


Stanfield with the starting line advantage and power to hold on for the hole shot win.

Dallas Glenn was 17 - 0 in Rd. 1 last year.  Jeg Coughlin has lost 6 straight races to Glenn.

Glenn is 8 - 2 against Coughlin in prior events. 

A couple great lights, with Jeg getting a couple tick advantage. Glenn had the difference made up by
300 feet and never trailed from there on for the win.

Anderson in his last 101 races.

Anderson is 17 - 3 against Kramer in prior events. 

Anderson with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  These two with the two
quickest pass of the round.

Smith to win here in 1990

Hartford is 5 - 0 against Delco in prior events. 

Hartford with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He will have lane choice
over Aaron Stanfield in the next round.

Greg Stanfield with severe tire shake right at the hit and pushed in the clutch.

Cody Coughlin is one of 56 PS drivers to qualify #1 more than once.  The last time the #16 PS
qualifier won in Rd. 1 here was 2012. (L. Morgan)

Coughlin is 1 - 0 against McGaha in prior events. 

McGaha with the starting line advantage, but Coughlin had the difference made up by 250 feet.  He
